budget.adoption_interval: Preregister paired log-ratio bootstrap at 95%; each independent qualified window must have lower bound on left/right >= 1/0.95 for a claimed 5% time reduction. Small-sample interval is descriptive and is not an equivalence or population guarantee.
budget.capacity_scope: Both per-owner caps and total active/retained resource ledger must be frozen against an equal-work F comparator; existing idle-pool and logical string limits are not total live-owner budgets.

Successful replacement invalidates old references under an explicit epoch/handle contract.
candidates.lifetime_cost: Transactional staging or rollback and retained old storage must be counted; do not assume overwrite-in-place preserves old state.

Same-Core versus variable/swap reuse and a load-only commit/rollback contract plus equal-work F pooled load+swap and total old/new/spare resource costs are not selected.
